data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fakhara', meaning 'to be proud' or 'to be honored'. The name Fakhriyya signifies a woman who carries herself with dignity, pride, and self-respect. The name Fakhriyya carries the meaning “Proud, Honorable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fakhriyya usually hope their child will grow to embody proud, honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakhriyya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
